summary: Full backend and frontend pass on the Play Store readiness and marketplace round. Backend: the existing suites pass (32/32: test_extras 6, test_marketplace 5, test_seed 6, test_landvilla_api 15, each run with -n 0). The new public-URL E2E suite test_iteration4_public_e2e.py passes 8/8. It covers legal pages and the deletion form, owner listing to moderation (duplicate flags, request-changes note required, reject, approve), public search, SEO index/noindex and sitemap, the broker gate (403 then apply then approve then post), enquiry consent and phone masking, lead patch, messages, report and resolve, block (403), account deletion with a fresh Mongo user (old session 403 reauth_required, then 200, then token 401), featured plans and order 503, and commission transitions (evidence and deal value enforced, payment 403). Frontend (375x667 web): every requested flow works end to end in the UI. No red screens or page errors. Only minor UX and privacy issues were found.

minor.issue: Returns the lister's private CRM lead status (new/contacted/follow_up/closed). The buyer UI shows it as a 'Follow-up' badge (app/enquiry/[id].tsx:44, marketplace.py:457). The lister's pipeline status should not be shown to the buyer.

There is no endpoint or UI action to mark a web-form deletion request as processed or completed. GET /admin/reports lists open requests forever (extras.py:258). Admin needs a resolve/complete action with an audit note.
Public unauthenticated form with no rate limit or captcha, so it can be spammed (extras.py:119-125).
Featured purchases are restricted to web only on the client (src/lister.ts:9 Platform.OS === 'web'). The backend has no platform guard. Acceptable for now, but note it for store compliance.

ui_bugs.issue: Raw Pydantic messages are shown with no field context, e.g. 'String should have at least 3 characters' repeated 5x on commission create.
Shows the raw reason slug 'wrong_info' and type 'PROPERTY' instead of human labels.

issues: Block applies instantly with no confirm dialog.
The blocked party still sees an enabled message input and only learns about the block from a toast after sending.
On web, the phone TextInput's focus outline is drawn inside the +91 container and looks misaligned (cosmetic).

action_items: Hide the lister's CRM status from the buyer enquiry view, or map it to a buyer-safe status (marketplace.py:457, app/enquiry/[id].tsx:44).
Add an admin action to complete or close web deletion requests (endpoint + button on /admin/reports) with an audit trail.
Rate-limit POST /api/legal/delete-account, e.g. per IP or per email.
Map Pydantic validation errors to friendly, field-named messages in the admin sheets, and use human labels for report reasons.
Optional: add a confirm step before Block, and disable the thread input for the blocked party.
Code size: marketplace.py is 831 lines (>700). Split it into listings/leads/payments modules.
critical_code_review_comments: Blocking on one thread blocks the buyer from enquiring on any of that lister's properties ('You can't contact this lister'). This is probably intended; confirm.

app.json is compliant: CAMERA, RECORD_AUDIO, READ_MEDIA_*, storage and SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW are blocked, and the image-picker camera and mic permissions are off. No deprecated expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or background-fetch.

Environment: the Expo process crashed once at the start of testing (expo CLI 'Unexpected token <... not valid JSON' from an update check). Supervisor restarted it and the bundle served 200 afterwards.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows functional; minor UX issues only

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ users, sessions, listings, enquiries, reports and commissions, then cleaned them up. The broker test user's profile was reset, re-applied via the UI and approved again, so it ends in the same approved state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Owner and broker tokens: test_session_owner_landvilla, test_session_broker_landvilla (missing from test_credentials.md; add them). On web, set localStorage auth_token. RN-web bottom sheets animate in: wait about 800ms, then use dispatch_event('click') on confirm buttons. Photo upload: page.expect_file_chooser on add-photo-btn or broker-add-doc-btn. For account deletion, create a fresh user and session in Mongo. Slug 'ujjainestate' does not exist (404). Use a real locality slug such as patni-bazaar.
